note: Proxy relevance = same oracle role family (Q-R3); it measures agreement with the metadata, not fit. Recall per JD over JDs with a relevant CV; CIs resample JDs (10,000). TF-IDF's IDF is the shared A2 vectoriser (a seeded train-region sample, unsupervised).
